quest.title: The Blazing Stars Ring in Fortune
quest.description: Lantern Rite has come around again. You and Paimon go and ask the people of Liyue about this year's festival preparations.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

chapter.num: Fleeting Colors in Flight: Part I
chapter.title: The Blazing Stars Ring in Fortune

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: ...Send this report to the Ministry of Civil Affairs and have them delegate each of the tasks on the list to the appropriate departments.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Also, be sure to tell them that though the Lantern Rite may be complicated, everything must be done properly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello, Lady Ningguang! It's us again!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're not disturbing you, are we?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: No, of course not. You are my honored guests.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: And given the looks of you two, I presume that you are here to celebrate the Lantern Rite?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right! So what's on the agenda for the festival this year?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: As always, there will be a variety of activities taking place. Oh, but there is one of particular interest... The Ministry of Civil Affairs is planning a fireworks show this year. It should certainly be worth your time.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Releasing Mingxiao Lanterns has always been at the heart of the Lantern Rite, but with all that has occurred in Liyue as of late, I think the people of the city need something to warm their hearts, a feeling of everyone coming together in solidarity.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: So, I believe that this year calls for a celebration of particular magnificence, something that would be closer to the hearts of every citizen.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: We are currently in the process of placing fireworks at various locations all throughout Liyue. We shall choose a timely moment during the festival to set off all the fireworks in unison, allowing the sparkling lights and excitement to resonate with the hearts of the people.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Fireworks? But we've already seen fireworks in other places before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is there something special about the fireworks in Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Fireworks were originally developed alongside many other inventions here in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: When our ancestors first created fireworks, they were originally known as "firecrackers." Their bright flashes and loud sounds were often used for warding off beasts or as warning signals to other people.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: In those days, it was difficult for people to contact one another while out farming the land, so they would carry firecrackers with them to give signals when necessary.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: But people's lifestyles began to change after Liyue Harbor was founded. They no longer had to travel out of town to tend the fields anymore, so the use of firecrackers for emergencies also began to dwindle.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: But through our local customs, the pioneering spirit of the firecrackers has been passed down to this very day.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: We made improvements to firecrackers and began setting them off during the Lantern Rite to commemorate the tenacious spirit of our ancestors.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Classic Liyue...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, everything has so much history in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: As I am sure you already know, everything on this land accumulates history and value as time passes. That is the nature of Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I've left Keqing in charge of the fireworks show. If you're interested, why don't we pay her a visit together?

talks.objective: Go to the Liyue fireworks stall

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Hmm, we need to add a few more locations for launching fireworks. The show has to be visible all across Liyue, not just in the city. They celebrate Lantern Rite in Qingce Village too, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Pengyi
dialogues.text: B—But Lady Keqing, what about our budget...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: The budget is exactly what it's meant to be. It's the necessary amount of funds to properly carry out a task.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: If you think the current budget will not suffice, then we'll simply have to apply for more funding from the Ministry of Civil Affairs and wait for their approval.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Our aim is to organize a memorable Lantern Rite. The budget is there just to facilitate planning, we mustn't lose sight of our goal.

dialogues.speaker: Pengyi
dialogues.text: Yes, Lady Keqing. I understand.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Good, and please remember, safety first.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Oh, it's Ningguang and the Traveler! Good to see you.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Are you here for the Lantern Rite? Your timing couldn't be any better, the preparations are almost complete.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you working on, Keqing?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I'm reviewing the positioning of the fireworks and double-checking the relevant facilities... It's all in a day's work.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Forgive my directness, but if I'm not mistaken, you could just as easily leave these tasks to your subordinates. You've already been working around the clock these past few days, I'm sure a break would not be amiss.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: No, it's fine. Really, I can handle it.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Pengyi, please redraft our plans, make a summary report, and send it to the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I'm going into town to check the progress of the fireworks setup. I'll return shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: As for you, Traveler, you're our esteemed guest. Please take the opportunity to stay in Liyue Harbor and enjoy the festivities.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Pengyi, is everything clear? Please remember the tasks I've given you.

dialogues.speaker: Pengyi
dialogues.text: Yes, Lady Keqing! Don't worry.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Good. Ningguang, Traveler, goodbye for now.

dialogues.speaker: Pengyi
dialogues.text: Please excuse me, Lady Ningguang, and uh... Traveler, I must get going.

dialogues.speaker: Pengyi
dialogues.text: Lady Keqing told me a great deal of information, and I have to write up the plans from scratch again, so time is of the essence.

dialogues.speaker: Pengyi
dialogues.text: Ooh! One moment, I almost forgot!

dialogues.speaker: Pengyi
dialogues.text: Here, Traveler, this is a Launch Tube. Lady Keqing said you may be interested, so she had me keep one to give to you.

dialogues.speaker: Pengyi
dialogues.text: Someone with good handicraft skills should be able to use this to design their very own fireworks. You should try it when you have the chance!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, Paimon couldn't get a single word in just now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, well, more like Paimon didn't dare open her mouth while they were talking, but still!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Keqing definitely had an imposing presence...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you notice it too? Lady Keqing is a lot more outspoken than she used to be!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And she seems a whole lot busier, too. Wonder why...

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Ever since the adepti left Liyue Harbor in the hands of mortals, we Qixing have taken up the responsibility of leading the people.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: We have taken charge of many vital tasks in various sectors, and we are responsible for planning and organizing all sorts of affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: That said, being in charge of everything inevitably takes its toll. It's exhausting at times.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Jiangzhou was responsible for planning the Lantern Rite in former years, but her father is getting quite old now, so she transferred to another department this year.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: In the end, the Lantern Rite planning was left to Keqing and myself. I am the head organizer, while Keqing is responsible for the highly anticipated fireworks show.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Such an important event should be entrusted to the most qualified candidate. Keqing is disciplined, yet passionate about her work, so she's naturally the best fit for the job.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She's definitely disciplined... no doubt about that.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Absolutely. She is strict with both herself and others, to the point that she can even become overly involved at times. She's worked several days without a break now.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I'm concerned about the effects it may have in the long run.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Finding balance is an essential concept in Liyue culture.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I've tried talking to her, but you know how she is... She uses her wit to talk circles around anyone...

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Traveler, you are quite close to Keqing, why don't you try talking to her? Maybe she'd listen to someone as experienced as you.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Thank you, Traveler. I am glad you are able to help. Keqing can be a tough nut to crack, sometimes.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: I still have other business to attend to at the Jade Chamber. I'll leave Keqing in your capable hands.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Ningguang leaves.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, are you sure you can really persuade Keqing to take a break? Even Ningguang herself couldn't manage to convince her...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Besides, before you can persuade someone, you have to at least understand how they feel at the moment.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Keqing has been working non-stop without a break.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So she must feel... very tired?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Duh! C'mon, everyone knows that! Think harder, how does she feel deep, deep down inside?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm, or maybe... we could ask a friend. You know, someone more knowledgeable about these things?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's go talk to Zhongli, then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Zhongli?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: He's really knowledgeable about the people of Liyue.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, there's no arguing that! Zhongli it is, then!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks he's still a consultant at the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Let's go see if he's there!

talks.objective: Go to Wangsheng Funeral Parlor and look for Zhongli

dialogues.speaker: Ferrylady
dialogues.text: Hello, how may I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're looking for your consultant, Zhongli.

dialogues.speaker: Ferrylady
dialogues.text: Ah, yes... Well, I'm afraid he is currently out with the director.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Out with the director? You mean, for work?

dialogues.speaker: Ferrylady
dialogues.text: The director said that they were going for a walk.

dialogues.speaker: Ferrylady
dialogues.text: If you'd prefer, you could go look for them at Third-Round Knockout.

dialogues.speaker: Ferrylady
dialogues.text: I've heard the director often goes there to do... uh, promotion.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Yum... Whew, I'm so full, not another bite!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Hats off to you, Xiangling, serving the grilled fish with a dipping sauce is quite an innovative approach, the flavor is just to die for!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, that's my signature dipping sauce. I knew it would taste great!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Hmm. Tempered Jueyun Chili powder mixed with garlic paste and chopped scallions... Then seasoned with salt, vinegar, and soy sauce, before finally sizzling in hot oil.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: This recipe may seem a bit crude, but is entirely hinged on the precise balancing of flavors and seasonings by the chef. Everything must be balanced just right.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: It is the consummate mastery of this balance that turns a humble dish into an exquisite one.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Oooh! That's quite the compliment, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hee-hee... I am flattered. Thank you, Mr. Zhongli!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: And I thought I have a way with words, but you certainly take the prize, Mr. Zhongli.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: You are too kind, Director. Your eloquence is *ahem* infamous in Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: What's that? Would you like to order something, Guoba? Please, by all means, it's my treat! I'll just open a tab under "Xiangling"!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, are you guys talking about tasty food again?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Oh! It's the Traveler and Paimon! What brings you to this side of town?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Hold on! Let me take a wild guess. Hmm, yes... Oh, you must be here for the Lantern Rite!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, isn't that pretty obvious? Anybody could have guessed that!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Aiya, c'mon! Can't you take a joke!?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: You came at the perfect time, I was just letting everyone try my latest dish!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: The owner of Third-Round Knockout says it's... well, a real knockout. Mr. Zhongli and Hu Tao seem to like it too, but I think it never hurts to let more people do a taste test.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: How about it, you two? Would you like to have a taste?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't have to ask Paimon twice! Or once, even!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you, but we're here to see Mr. Zhongli.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Y—You mean we're not gonna try any? Aww, fine, let's get down to business...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: We meet again, Traveler. I trust your journey is going well?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not bad, we've learned a lot along the way.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Splendid, therein lies the value of a journey.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: So, c'mon! Why are you looking for our good consultant? Do enlighten us.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: And just in case you were wondering, we are on business, too! We only tried Xiangling's dish since we just happened to be here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Business? What kind of business would the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor possibly have during a festival?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Even during the most joyous of holidays, life still follows its natural course, does it not? Is that really so surprising? But there isn't need to be alarmed, it's just a nice day today and I thought we could go for a walk while doing a little promotion for our business.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: You can go ahead and chat away. Xiangling and I will go have some tea with the boss over there. Zhongli, please come get me when you're through here!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Of course, I'll see you later, Director.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Now then, Traveler, what brings you to see me today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, long story short...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You explain Keqing's situation to Zhongli.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Hmm, yes. The Yuheng is honest, intelligent, and most diligent. She is capable of shouldering responsibilities that few others could, but everything has a balance, and one's health must certainly weigh in.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there any way we can help her?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah. Everyone knows you're super knowledgeable, Paimon bets she would listen to someone like you!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: If I were still the mighty Rex Lapis, I might be able to help her see reason. But alas, I'm now nobody but an ordinary consultant. My words no longer carry the same weight as they once did.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Besides, I am by no means close to the Yuheng. Taking the liberty to lecture her may just as easily produce the opposite of the desired effect.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, you're right... Then what should we do?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: We could take a more subtle, indirect approach to the matter.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Such as telling a story that resonates with her, containing your message conveyed within it.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Such a story can be achieved by referencing topics from her daily life. The story could prove even more effective if you weave in something about someone close to her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Umm, Paimon doesn't really get it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go speak with others who are familiar with Keqing.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I knew you'd understand what to do, haha. Well done, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Go collect some source materials for your story. Of course, I can always provide you with my advice, if needed.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Once we have formulated the plot, you can tell the story to the Yuheng.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh? Me?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: You are on amiable terms with the Yuheng, which makes you the natural candidate.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon gets it! So we need to talk with people who know Keqing, right? Hmm, so who should we start with?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Greetings everyone, I hope I'm not intruding.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh, L—Lady Keqing!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Mr. Zhongli, I didn't expect to see you here. Thank you for all your assistance during the Rite of Parting.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: You are most welcome, Yuheng. It was the least I could do.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Erm, what are you doing here, Keqing?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Hmm, why? And what's with your strange expression?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Oh, I see, my apologies, I appear to have interrupted your conversation with Mr. Zhongli.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No, no, not at all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Keqing, are you here looking for us?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Yes, I was going to ask you to introduce me to the adepti. I thought that it would be fitting to send them some festive gifts on behalf of the Liyue Qixing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But didn't you meet them when we were fighting to defend Liyue Harbor together?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You could just as easily go and find them in Jueyun Karst.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Yes, but we only met briefly on that single occasion. The adepti may have already forgotten about me, and I'm concerned it would be imprudent to show up so suddenly.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Which is why I thought it would be more appropriate to ask you to introduce me first.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you even have to run around delivering gifts in person... It sure doesn't seem easy to be a Qixing.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We'll gladly help you.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Thank you, Traveler. Let me go and prepare the gifts.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I'm sorry to make you run errands with me during our big festival. I promise to make this quick, and I'll be sure to get you back in time to enjoy the fireworks show.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Great, then we go watch the fireworks together!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Huh? T—Together?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Hmm, alright. I'll go to see the fireworks with you once I've finished my work.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Speaking of which, Mr. Zhongli, the Fireworks Show will be particularly exciting this year. Please, don't miss it.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Ah, yes. Thank you for your kind reminder.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I should be going now. Traveler, please come find me at the Jade Chamber once you're ready.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And there she goes.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: That's the Yuheng, efficient and reliable as ever.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're really reliable too, Zhongli!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Why, thank you, Paimon.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Please don't forget our earlier conversation. Once you've collected enough story material, we can meet here again and discuss things further.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Unfortunately, Ganyu is on leave at the moment, so I'm unable to get in touch with her.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I'm afraid I'll still require your assistance.

dialogues.speaker: Ferrylady
dialogues.text: If you're looking for the director and our consultant, you can go look for them at Third-Round Knockout. I've heard the director often goes there to do... uh, promotion.
